notes: Reference aerodynamic coefficients for validating Open Grid car configs. Values are reproduced from the cited sources; see data/physics/SOURCES.md and docs/downforce-data.md for licences and assumptions. Cl convention: positive = downforce. Our cars use ClA (downforce_area_m2) and CdA (drag_area_m2) directly.

frontal_area_m2.note: Assumed passenger-car frontal area for converting DrivAer Cd to a CdA band. The DrivAer reference area was not re-derived here; this is an explicit assumption, not a measured value.

assumptions.downforce_bound_note: Upper bound for ClA = cl_max x 1.0 m^2 wing plus a modest underbody contribution; values above this need explicit evidence.

balance_reference.class: covered-wheel road car with a front splitter
balance_reference.note: Use only as a class proxy. No measured front/rear balance under a reusable licence was found (see docs/downforce-data.md). The range spans the rigid-closed (0.676) and inflated-open (0.859) configurations; it is not a specification for our cars.

race_car_downforce_evidence.note: The wing bound above (cl_max x 1 m^2 x 1.15) fits road cars and small wings. A race car also makes downforce with the floor, splitter and diffuser. A car listed in 'cars' may go up to bound_margin x the largest implied ClA of the evidence entries named for it. The implied ClA = downforce / (0.5 rho v^2) at the file's air density.
